description:
Why this issue exists: email/set.rs handle_email_set() returns hardcoded 'oldState': '0', 'newState': '0' with an inline comment that these are overridden by the caller. Without reading server.rs, it is unclear why placeholder values are used or whether the override always happens. A future refactor that moves the call site could silently break state reporting.

What needs to be done: Replace the inline comment with a clearer one: '// Placeholder values; caller (route_method) patches in real old/new state after this returns. // See the P1 issue: pass state explicitly to eliminate this indirection.' Better yet, eliminate the pattern by passing state as a parameter (filed as stoa-ftx6h.51).
title: Email/set: oldState/newState '0' literals lack explaining comment
